gloss: sense of orientation (to time, place, person)

definitions.gloss: orientation; awareness of time, place, and person
definitions.explanation: The cognitive ability to know what day it is, where one is, and who is around. A standard clinical assessment item; its loss ({見当識障害|けんとうしきしょうがい}) is a hallmark of dementia and other cognitive impairment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見当識|けんとうしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧してきた。
examples.english: My grandmother's orientation has been declining.

⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、{見当識|けんとうしき}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Disorientation often appears as an early symptom of dementia.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧ (rough estimate; bearings) + {識|しき} (consciousness; recognition). Almost exclusively a clinical/medical term — not used about day-to-day getting lost.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見当識|けんとうしき}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧: disorientation; orientation impairment
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧/⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧/⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{見当識|けんとうしき}: orientation to time / place / person
- {見当識|けんとうしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: orientation declines

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {方向感覚|ほうこうかんかく}: sense of direction — about navigating space, not clinical awareness
- ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: consciousness — broader; whether one is awake and aware
